notes: Initial shared-data register seeded from current code review findings.
Entries require service-owner review and formal classification approval.

entries.business_justification: System or unscoped jobs may need shared visibility, but the behavior is audit-sensitive and must be explicitly approved.

entries.storage_surface: OpenSearch ingest pipeline and index template metadata
entries.pattern: GET /ingest/pipelines and GET /ingest/templates return shared platform configuration metadata
entries.business_justification: Pipeline and template metadata describe platform-managed ingest configuration and should not contain tenant customer data.

entries.storage_surface: agent versions and hardened image catalog
entries.pattern: GET /api/v1/agents* and GET /api/v1/hardened-images* return platform-managed product catalog metadata
entries.business_justification: Agent version information and hardened image catalog entries are product-managed catalog content intended to be visible across tenants and should not contain tenant customer data.

entries.pattern: tenant_id IS NULL or tenant_id = tenant / sg-admin tenant
entries.business_justification: Global policy templates are intended to be reusable starting points across tenants and should contain no tenant customer data.

entries.pattern: tenant_id IS NULL rows are written only through superadmin-scoped framework loader routes, while generic RAG write APIs are tenant-owned
entries.business_justification: Shared cybersecurity knowledge is intended to be globally reusable, while tenant-specific knowledge must remain isolated. Mutable tenant writes should not be able to create or modify shared rows through generic tenant APIs.

entries.pattern: tenant_id IS NULL rows remain globally readable for browsing and on-demand generation, but schedule state is only allowed on tenant-owned templates
entries.business_justification: System report templates are seeded product content intended to be reusable across tenants and should not embed tenant-specific data. Mutable schedule state must remain tenant-owned to avoid cross-tenant coupling.
